question: Who among the following Indians was selected as a member of International Law Commission for a 5 year term starting January 1, 2023 in the month of November 2021?
solution:
The correct option is **__Bimal Patel.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ILC was formed on **November 21, 1947,** by the **UNGA**.
 
• Bimal Patel has been elected to the ILC for a five year term starting January 1, 2023.
 
• Its headquarter is in **Geneva, Switzerland**. 
 
• ILC is a body of experts that helps in developing and codifying international law.
 
• ILC will hold its** 73rd session** at the UNO in Geneva from **18 April to 3 June and from 4 July to 5 August 2022**.
